title: Scheme-Frobenius forms of Weil equivariance
statement:
Precomposing the vertical maps of the three squares of
[thm-pur-weil-equivariance-of-purity-and-trace] with the
corresponding $\kappa_X$ or $\kappa_Y$ of
[def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius] gives the same three squares
for the scheme-Frobenius maps $u_N$.

proof.text: Use the coefficient category and datum of [thm-pur-weil-equivariance-of-purity-and-trace]. For $T=X,Y$ write $F_T=L\Phi_T^*$ and $G_T=Lg_{T,\gamma}^*$. Take the specified natural comparison $\kappa_T:F_T\xrightarrow{\sim}G_T$ of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius], in the coefficient category supplied in the statement. The definition [def-pur-compact-support-transport] identifies $u_M$ with $\varphi_M\circ\kappa_{T,M}$, including for whole compact-support objects. Apply [lem-pur-natural-comparison-strict-intertwiners]: every given geometric-equivariance equality becomes $h u_M=u_NF_T(h)$, with the same lower arrow, and strict vertical maps stay invertible with inverse $\kappa_{T,M}^{-1}\varphi_M^{-1}$.

source.place: Entire proof: comparison of the two pullbacks, compatibility with pullback-composition and f, and preservation of the squares

proof.text:
On $X$ take $M=Lf^*K(d)[2d]$, $N=Rf^!K$, $h=\gamma_{f,K}$. The purity square of [thm-pur-weil-equivariance-of-purity-and-trace] supplies the hypothesis of [lem-pur-natural-comparison-strict-intertwiners], hence
$$\gamma_{f,K}u_{Lf^*K(d)[2d]}=u_{Rf^!K}L\Phi_X^*(\gamma_{f,K}).$$
For the pullback-composition identifications, apply [lem-pur-natural-comparison-functor-transport] with $L=Lf^*$ and $c_F=c_\Phi$, $c_G=c_g$. Its compatibility hypothesis is exactly $c_g(Lf^*\kappa_Y)=(\kappa_XLf^*)c_\Phi$ of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Thus the specified comparison agrees in either pullback presentation. The displayed square uses the comparison at the whole twisted and shifted source object.

proof.text:
On $Y$ apply [lem-pur-natural-comparison-strict-intertwiners] to the exceptional counit $h=\operatorname{Tr}_{f,K}:Rf_!Rf^!K\to K$ and to the normalized smooth trace $h=\operatorname{Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}:Rf_!Lf^*K(d)[2d]\to K$. Use the compact-support data of [def-pur-compact-support-transport]. The theorem [thm-pur-weil-equivariance-of-purity-and-trace] supplies both geometric equalities, including the counit clause stated in words. We obtain
$$\operatorname{Tr}_{f,K}u_{Rf_!Rf^!K}=u_KL\Phi_Y^*(\operatorname{Tr}_{f,K}),\qquad \operatorname{Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}u_{Rf_!Lf^*K(d)[2d]}=u_KL\Phi_Y^*(\operatorname{Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}).$$
Together with the purity square these are the three required squares, each obtained by precomposing its vertical pair; no Cartesian base change for the scheme-Frobenius square is used.
